mapper.select: SELECT id, document_id, chunk_no, chunk_type, heading_path, content_text, keyword_text, region_scope, doc_type, topic_type, policy_name, policy_aliases, policy_no, chapter_title, section_title, scene_priority, searchable, content_length, sort_no FROM ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT doc.id AS document_id, chunk.id AS chunk_id, doc.doc_title, doc.policy_region, chunk.heading_path, chunk.content_text AS snippet, chunk.keyword_text, chunk.region_scope, chunk.doc_type, chunk.topic_type, chunk.policy_name, chunk.policy_aliases, chunk.policy_no, chunk.chapter_title, chunk.section_title, chunk.scene_priority, chunk.searchable, chunk.chunk_no FROM ai_knowledge_chunk chunk INNER JOIN ai_knowledge_document doc ON doc.id = chunk.document_id WHERE doc.is_deleted = FALSE AND chunk.base_id = #{baseId} ORDER BY doc.update_time DESC, chunk.sort_no ASC, chunk.id ASC
